description: Contents: Indoor Grown Flower - (28g) Nose/Flavor: Toffee, Caramel, Coffee, Cedar, Pine, Black Pepper, Citrus, Earthy, Herbal Spice Acapulco Gold is a legendary Sativa strain known for its golden-green appearance and uplifting cerebral effects. It delivers a rich flavor of creamy caramel and sweet toffee, layered with earthy coffee, cedar, and fresh pine, finishing with a lingering touch of black pepper and spice. The aroma combines warm brown sugar and dark toffee with pungent citrus peel, earth, and herbal spice. Its clear-headed, energetic effects promote euphoria, focus, creativity, and a cheerful, social mood, making it well suited for daytime use.

Contents: Outdoor Grown Flower - (28g) Nose/Flavor: Earthy, Skunky, Licorice, Fruity Lineage: Platinum OG x Blackberry x Girl Scout Cookies Berry Noir is a strong marijuana strain that is produced by mating Platinum OG, Blackberry and Girl Scout Cookies together. All these three strains are well known for producing excellent and powerful effects on the tokers. Berry Noir is an Indica dominant hybrid that was also featured in the LA Medical Cannabis Cup 2014. It has green colored spongy nuggs that are covered with shiny trichome resin as well as plenty of thin red colored hair. The strain has an excellent potency so its THC level is assumed to be quite high, but the exact value isn't known. It burns very smoothly and has a very fine and clean smoke. It has an earthy odor with a fruity hint that gives off a skunky smell in the end. Its taste is quite smooth and is a blend of earthy, fruity and licorice flavors. It instantly makes you drowsy and calms your nerves. Due to these effects, it is excellent for treating stress and insomnia. Medical patients of anxiety and depression can also rely on it to relax them. Its side effects include couch-lock.

Contents: Greenhouse Grown Flower - (14g) Nose/Flavor: Chocolate, Sweetness, Funky, Sour Finish Lineage: Mind Flayer x Hood Candyz Experience a boost in creativity, sharpened focus, heightened sensory perception, and an uplifted mood. Experience a boost in creativity, sharpened focus, heightened sensory perception, and an uplifted mood.

Contents: Greenhouse Grown Flower - (14g) Nose/Flavor: Blueberry, Citrus, Earthy Lineage: Blueberry x Haze The Blue Dream strain from Nanticoke is a sativa-dominant hybrid celebrated for its balanced effects and rich flavor profile. This strain is the result of crossing Blueberry with Haze. The flower is greenhouse-grown and packaged in eco-friendly compostable jars, reflecting Nanticoke’s sustainability focus. Its aroma is dominated by sweet blueberry notes, layered with hints of citrus, earthiness, and hash, while the flavor profile delivers smooth berry sweetness with citric earthiness and faint cheese-like undertones. Users often describe the effects as happy, euphoric, creative, and focused, making it ideal for daytime use when productivity and stress relief are desired without heavy sedation.

Contents: Indoor Grown Flower - (28g) Nose/Flavor: Blueberry, Sweet, Buttery Dough, Vanilla, Earthy Spice Lineage: Blueberry × Purple Panty Dropper Blueberry Muffin is an indica-dominant hybrid with a sweet, dessert-inspired profile and mellow, relaxing effects. It delivers a warm body relaxation paired with a clear, happy mental buzz. The flavor features sugary blueberry jam, buttery pastry, and creamy vanilla, while the aroma resembles freshly baked blueberry muffins with earthy spice undertones.

Contents: Sun Grown Flower - (28g) Nose/Flavor: Sweet, Fruity, Smooth Lineage: Chemdawg Guava x Blue Steel The Plug Pack’s Bomb Pop, a sativa that hits just like your favorite frozen treat. This berry-lime strain delivers a balanced, uplifting high that’s perfect for getting creative or enjoying a sunny day. Experience a quality high that’s as refreshing as a summer breeze!

Contents: Indoor Grown Flower - (28g) Nose/Flavor: Cheese, Creamy, Sour, Earthy, SPice Lineage: Cheese x OG Kush Zips OG Cheese Cake is a flavorful, terpene-rich cultivar that blends the unmistakable funk of classic Cheese genetics with the sweet, creamy characteristics associated with dessert strains. Cheese Cake is typically bred from the legendary Cheese lineage crossed with OG Kush or other indica-dominant genetics, creating a strain that balances pungent savory notes with rich sweetness. The flavor profile is what truly sets Cheese Cake apart. On the inhale, it delivers a distinctive cheesy, creamy funk with notes of sour dairy and earthy spice, followed by layers of sweet vanilla, sugary pastry, and rich baked-goods flavors that emerge on the exhale. The effects are typically soothing yet euphoric, beginning with a pleasant mood lift that helps melt away stress and promote a relaxed, carefree mindset.

Contents: Sun Grown Flower - (3.5g) Nose/Flavor: Sweet Cherry, Tart Fruit, Berry, Warm Baking Spice, Herbal Lineage: Granddaddy Purple x Durban Poison Cherry Pie is an indica strain bred from Granddaddy Purple and Durban Poison, delivering a sweet and fruity profile with tart cherry, berry, warm baking spice, and herbal undertones. The effects are relaxing, euphoric, and gently uplifting, making it well suited for unwinding and enjoying a calm, comfortable experience.

Contents: Mixed-Light Ground Flower - (14g) Nose/Flavor: Earthy, Herbal, Pine, Citrus, Lime Notes, Skunky Notes Chronic Tonic features a clean, refreshing profile highlighted by earthy herbal aromas layered with bright pine and citrus notes. The flavor follows with a smooth blend of sweet herbs and light spice, finishing with a subtle lime-like zest on the exhale. Balanced and crisp, this strain stands out for its fresh, tonic-inspired sensory experience.

Contents: Mixed-Light Grown Flower - (28g) Nose/Flavor: Garlic, Buttery, Hint of Diesel, Slight Pepper Finish Lineage: GMO x Fortune Cookies True to its name, Garlic Budder carries a distinctive savory garlic profile layered with notes of buttery smoothness, earthy spice, and a hint of diesel, creating a flavor that’s both unusual and memorable. The buds themselves tend to be dense and frosty, coated in a thick layer of trichomes that signal its strength and resin production. On the inhale, users often notice a rich, umami-like depth, followed by a warm, slightly peppery finish that lingers pleasantly. Its effects usually lean toward a heavy, calming body melt paired with a mellow, hazy euphoria, making it a favorite for unwinding at the end of the day or settling into a deeply relaxed headspace.

Contents: Indoor Grown Flower - (14g) Nose/Flavor: Sweet, Diesel, Spice, Pepper, Earthy, Herbal, Cookie-Like, Hint of Cherry & Citrus Lineage: The Y × Snowman Zips OG's Gary Payton delivers a complex aroma and flavor profile that blends sweet diesel, spicy pepper, earthy herbs, and sugary cookie notes, accented by hints of cherry, citrus, and lavender-like floral undertones. On the inhale, users often notice a smooth mix of sweet dough and fuel, while the exhale leaves behind a peppery, slightly nutty finish with lingering gas-forward flavors. The effects are where Gary Payton truly shines. This hybrid typically begins with a fast-acting cerebral uplift that promotes euphoria, focus, mental clarity, and sociability, making conversations and creative activities feel more engaging. As the high develops, a soothing body relaxation gradually settles in without overwhelming sedation, creating a balanced experience that keeps the mind active while easing physical tension.

Contents: Indoor Grown Flower - (28g) Nose/Flavor: Diesel, Gas, Citrus, Mint, Herbal, Earthy, Nutty, Sugary Cookie Dough Lineage: Face Mints x Biscotti x Sherbet Gas Face is a potent Indica strain known for its loud, pungent aroma and rich gas-dessert flavor profile. It opens with intense diesel, jet gas, and chemical skunk, balanced by earthy pine and peppery spice. The flavor brings sour citrus, sharp mint, and herbal diesel on the inhale, followed by nutty earthiness and a smooth sugary cookie dough finish. Its effects deliver deep physical relaxation and a heavy, calming sensation, making it well suited for unwinding and evening use.

Contents: Indoor Grown Flower - (3.5g) Nose/Flavor: Savory garlic, onion, diesel, earthy funk, and spice. Lineage: Chemdawg × Girl Scout Cookies Leal’s GMO is an indica-hybrid strain with a bold, savory profile featuring pungent garlic and onion funk layered with diesel, earthy spice, and cheesy undertones. It delivers a happy, euphoric mental lift followed by deep full-body relaxation that can become sedating at higher doses.

Contents: Mixed-Light Grown Flower - (7.0g) Nose/Flavor: Tropical Fruit, Sugary Candy, Berry, Fruit Punch, Diesel, Gas, Spicy Herbal Notes, Earthy Undertones Lineage: Original Glue (GG4) × Zkittlez Leal's Gorilla Zkittlez is an indica-dominant hybrid known for its bold combination of sweet tropical fruit and heavy gas. The aroma opens with sugary candy and ripe fruit before giving way to pungent diesel, peppery gas, and earthy undertones. The flavor brings together sweet fruit punch and berry notes with a smooth gassy finish accented by subtle cocoa and spicy herbal tones. Its effects lean relaxing, beginning with a euphoric, uplifting head high before settling into a slow-creeping body relaxation, making Gorilla Zkittlez well suited for laid-back afternoons and evening sessions.

Contents: Indoor Grown Flower - (14g) Nose/Flavor: Sweet cream, vanilla, nutty cookies, diesel, earthy musk, and peppery spice. Lineage: Gorilla Glue #4 × Cookies & Cream Zips OG Grease Monkey is a powerful hybrid strain known for combining rich dessert-like flavors with deeply relaxing effects. Grease Monkey is traditionally bred from GG4 (Gorilla Glue #4) and Cookies & Cream, a lineage that gives it its signature blend of potency, resin production, and sweet, skunky character. In the Zips OG offering, the aroma is dominated by sweet vanilla-like notes, earthy kush, and pungent skunk, with subtle hints of creamy cookies and fuel lingering in the background. The flavor mirrors the scent closely, delivering a smooth combination of sweet cream, earthy spice, and skunky undertones that leave a rich, slightly savory finish on the palate. The effects of Grease Monkey are typically heavy and long-lasting, beginning with a wave of calm that gradually spreads throughout the body. While technically classified as a hybrid, many consumers find its experience leans toward the relaxing side, producing a deep body buzz, stress relief, and full-body comfort that can feel almost sedative at higher doses.

Contents: Pre-Ground Flower - (14g) Nose/Flavor: Sweet, Cotton Candy, Blue Raspberry, Strawberry, Black Cherry, Grape Soda, Tropical Fruit, Mango, Tart Citrus Lineage: Notorious T.H.C. x Very Cherry x Hella Jelly BX3 Hella Jelly is a sativa-dominant hybrid delivering an exceptionally sweet, candy-forward profile of cotton candy, blue raspberry, strawberry, black cherry, grape soda, and tropical fruit. The flavor carries juicy mango and ripe berries with a tart citrus finish. This energizing flower provides a clear-headed cerebral lift with uplifting, creative, social effects and a relaxed body feel.

Contents: Indoor Grown Flower - (28g) Nose/Flavor: Lemon, Citrus, Sweet, Vanilla, Cookie Dough, Diesel Lineage: Gelonade × Dosidos Illemonati is a Sativa strain known for its bold lemon-citrus profile and energizing daytime effects. It delivers sharp lemon zest and sweet citrus candy, followed by creamy vanilla, sugary cookie dough, and subtle diesel. Its uplifting effects provide euphoria, focus, creativity, and functional energy without heavy sedation, making it well suited for daytime use.

Contents: Mixed-Light Grown Flower - (14g) Nose/Flavor: Diesel, Fuel, Earthy, Pine, Pepper, Spice Jet Fuel is a potent sativa known for its sharp aroma, energizing effects, and bold flavor profile that hits with classic diesel character. This batch was hand-selected for its sticky, crystal-covered buds and loud terpene expression that delivers a strong, fast-acting experience. Jet Fuel presents an intense aroma of diesel fuel, earthy pine, and peppery spice. On the inhale, expect pungent gas notes layered with herbal pine and subtle earthy sweetness, followed by a smooth but powerful finish that lingers on the palate.

Contents: Indoor Grown Flower - (14g) Nose/Flavor: Pine, lemon zest, diesel, woody earth, herbal spice, and fuel. Lineage: OG Kush × LA Confidential King Louis XIII is an indica-dominant hybrid with a classic OG profile featuring pungent pine, citrus, diesel, earthy woods, and peppery spice. Its fast-acting effects deliver a euphoric mental calm followed by deep physical relaxation and heavy sedation, making it well suited for evening or nighttime use.

Contents: Greenhouse Grown Flower - (7.0g) Nose/Flavor: Chemical Diesel, Sweet, Fruity, Berries, Spicy Overtone Lineage: Silver Lemon Haze x Forbidden Fruit x Cherry Pie x Citral Glue Lilac Diesel is a cross between Silver Lemon Haze x Forbidden Fruit x with NYC Cherry Pie and Citral Glue. Aromas of sharp chemical diesel and sweet fruity berries are released, all with a spicy overtone. The flavor is on the lighter side of things, with a sweet fruity berry taste that is accented by sour citrus and pine. Your thoughts will meander as your body relaxes, while flavor rages on. You will find this strain soothing, restful, and wonderfully aromatic for a lackadaisical afternoon.

Contents: Mixed-Light Grown Flower - (14g) Nose/Flavor: Sweet, Floral, Fuel-Like, Funky Lineage: East Side OG x Fire 18 Nic The Bruiser is an indica hybrid East Side OG and Fire 18 that were crossbred to create this masterpiece. The terpenes that ooze from these trichomes are aromatically therapeutic alone. Nic the Bruiser gives off sweet and floral notes that are pulled together with a fuel-like OG funk. This strain offers long-lasting relief worth writing home about.

Contents: Sun Grown Flower - (28g) Nose/Flavor: Sweet, Nutty, Fruity, Jelly Lineage: LA Confidential x Peanut Butter Kush PB&J, also known as “PBJ,” is an evenly balanced hybrid strain created through crossing the delicious LA Confidential X Peanut Butter Kush strains. If you love a classic peanut butter and jelly sandwich, PB&J is perfect for you. This bud packs a sweet fruity flavor with hints of rich nutty peanut butter and a touch of spiciness to it.

Contents: Mixed-Light Grown Flower - (14g) Nose/Flavor: Melon-Sherbet, Citrus Zest, Funky Lineage: Zoap × Lazergun Pearlz flower combines dense, resinous structure with a complex aromatic profile featuring earthy, sweet, and fruity notes that translate beautifully to the palate. The terpene-rich experience provides uplifting and relaxed effects, making it versatile for various occasions. Whether you're seeking creative inspiration or unwinding after a long day, this half-ounce of Pearlz offers consistent quality and satisfying sessions. Preferred Gardens' commitment to cultivation excellence ensures each flower delivers the full spectrum of cannabinoids and terpenes for an authentic cannabis experience.

Contents: Mixed-Light Grown Flower - (3.5g) Nose/Flavor: Candy, Floral, Gas Lineage: Biscotti x Sherb x Jealousy Exclusive released the Permanent Marker weed strain in June 2022 on both coasts. Bred and grown by Seed Junky Genetics’ JBeezy and selected by Doja Pak, the strain fuses several well-established cultivars: Biscotti x Jealousy x Sherb Bx. Floral, soapy, candy, and gassy funk smells fully translate into the taste. It has a lingering, pungent flavor of a soapy funk with a hint of candy and floral gas tones. The potent strain brings out creativity for daytime relaxation, followed up by the munchies and the urge to roll up some more.

Contents: Mixed-Light Grown Flower - (3.5g) Nose/Flavor: Sweet, Fruity, Cherry-Berry, Tangy, Creamy, Citrus Lineage: Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies x Lemon Haze Platinum Lemon Cherry Gelato is a balanced hybrid strain created by crossing Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies and Lemon Haze. It features tight, dense olive-green buds with thick amber hairs and a layer of frosty amber trichomes. This strain offers a sweet, fruity cherry-berry flavor with tangy, creamy citrus lemon notes. The aroma mirrors the flavor profile with added hints of black pepper and fresh earthiness. The high begins with an uplifting euphoria, sparking creative motivation, and often leads to a case of the giggles.

Contents: Outdoor Grown Flower - (28g) Nose/Flavor: Diesel, Earthy Pine, Citrus, Creamy Finish Pressure OG from The Plug Pack is a potent hybrid known for its uplifting cerebral buzz paired with deep body relaxation. It carries a pungent, earthy aroma with pine and fuel notes, and its dense, resinous buds reflect careful, top-shelf cultivation. Users describe the experience as euphoric, relaxing, and creatively focusing, making it versatile for unwinding or sparking inspiration.

Contents: Indoor Grown Flower - (3.5g) Nose/Flavor: Diesel, Chemical, Sweet, Chocolate, Earthy Undertones, Hint of Grape Lineage: Chemdawg 91 x Pre-98 Bubba Kush Purple Chem boasts a complex and potent aroma, combining the strong diesel/chemical notes from the Chem 91 parent with the sweet chocolate/coffee and earthy undertones of Bubba Kush, often with hints of grape

Contents: Indoor Grown Flower - (28g) Nose/Flavor: Sweet, Lemon Lime, Ripe Grape, Spicy Berries, Candy, Diesel, Sour Fruit Lineage: Moonbow x Zkittlez A strikingly flavorful sativa from Archive Seed Bank and Purple City Genetics, born from Zkittlez crossed with Moonbow. Leafly's HighLight featured this cultivar as a favorite among hash heads and flavor chasers. Open a jar and the first wave is sweet-sour candy — citrus-lime ribbons and tropical fruit chews — followed by Kush spices, faint diesel, and pastry dough. The high launches with euphoric energy and sociability before settling into a calm, mellow body glow. Top terpenes: limonene, caryophyllene, and linalool.

Contents: Outdoor Grown Flower - (28g) Nose/Flavor: Sweet, Berry, Earthy, Herbal Sapphire Haze is a bright, aromatic strain known for its sweet, berry-leaning scent layered with earthy or herbal undertones. It’s presented as an uplifting, energetic variety, marketed for its vivid color palette and its smooth, clean smoke aesthetic.

Contents: Indoor Grown Flower - (3.5g) Nose/Flavor: Zesty, Orange, Pine, Cinnamon, Lavender Notes, Chamomile Notes, Herbal Undertones Lineage: Sour Diesel x Jack Herer Edie Parker brings energizing, flavor-forward cannabis with Early Bird - Sour Jack 3.5g, a sativa strain that’s a cross of Sour Diesel and Jack Herer. This hybrid bursts with bright, citrusy, and diesel-like aromas, delivering a crisp, invigorating flavor profile. Perfect for daytime creativity, social energy, or starting your morning with a boost, Early Bird - Sour Jack provides a potent, uplifting sativa high while reflecting Edie Parker’s commitment to clean, flavorful, and reliable cannabis.

Contents: Mixed-Light Grown Flower -(28g) Nose/Flavor: Sour, Dank, Pepper Lineage: Sharksbreath x OG Kush Stank Breath is an indica-hybrid strain made by crossing Sharksbreath and OG Kush. Like its name suggests, this bud has a super heavy and pungent aroma and flavor that's dank, musty and sour with a punch of deep black pepper. Stank Breath hits you almost instantly, filling your brain with a happy lifted sense of euphoria. As you soar higher, a soothing body tingle will begin to wash over you, lulling you into a state of pure relaxation and ease eventually into a fully sedated and couch locked state.

Contents: Sun Grown Flower - (28g) Nose/Flavor: Sweet, Cherry Candy, Orange Peel, Funky, Tropical Gas, Fruit Punch-Like Lineage: Black Cherry Punch × Tropicana Cookies Super Boof from Leal comes across as a loud, candy-sweet, and deeply resinous cultivar, and Leal’s living-soil approach gives it an especially rich, terpene-forward expression. The buds are typically dense and chunky with a thick frosting of trichomes that gives them a silvery sheen over bright greens and deep orange pistils. The aroma hits fast and heavy—cherry candy, orange peel, and a funky, almost tropical gas—a profile inherited from its parents, Black Cherry Punch × Tropicana Cookies. On the palate, the strain leans even sweeter, opening with fruit punch and cherry syrup before settling into a warm, earthy cookie note that adds depth beneath the brightness. The effects tend to land as a balanced hybrid: an immediate mood lift and mental clarity from the Tropicana side, followed by a warm, relaxing body feel that never becomes overly sedating. In Leal’s cultivation style, the strain often feels especially expressive—bold in flavor, smooth in the smoke, and layered in its high, making it a standout for people who enjoy fruit-forward strains with a euphoric but grounded finish.

Contents: Sun Grown Flower - (28g) Nose/Flavor: Citrus, Earthy, Berry, Lime Skip the OJ and start your morning off with this citrusy and earthy strain. This balanced hybrid strain will have you feeling happy while relaxed all in one, with higher testing THC and quality you can trust.

Contents: Mixed-Light Grown Flower - (14g) Nose/Flavor: Juicy Cherry, Citrus Candy, Sweet, Creamy, Tropical, Tart Gas, Light Spice Lineage: Zkittlez × Cherry Pie Urban Xtracts Wild Cherry Z is an indica with a sweet and fruity profile featuring juicy cherry and citrus candy layered with creamy sweetness, light spice, and tart gas. Its effects lean heavily toward deep physical relaxation, calm euphoria, and a soothing body high, making it well suited for unwinding in the evening and nighttime.

Experience the exceptional quality of Krazy Madness, a premium cannabis flower carefully cultivated by the experts at Finger Lakes Hydro LLC. Brought to you by 6 Points Cannabis, this top-tier dried marijuana is perfectly portioned in a convenient 3.5-gram package, making it an ideal choice for adult-use consumers. Krazy Madness delivers a vibrant and reliable flower experience you can trust.

Discover the bold character of ZIZZLE Black Magic, a premium 3.5g flower offering crafted for cannabis enthusiasts who appreciate rich flavor and exceptional quality. Black Magic delivers dense, carefully cultivated buds with a smooth, flavorful smoke featuring earthy notes complemented by subtle sweet and spicy undertones. Whether you're relaxing after a long day or elevating your next session, Black Magic provides a consistently enjoyable experience backed by ZIZZLE's commitment to premium cultivation and quality.

Black Maple comes from Harry Palms at Bloom Seed Co - Dulce de Uva (Grape Pie x OG Kush) crossed to Sherbanger. It's famous for foliage so dark it reads nearly black, fading to deep purple under our lights. The jar smells like its name: dark maple syrup and grape candy over a sticky, resinous earth. This is an unapologetic evening indica - a slow, heavy melt that's right at home after dinner with nowhere left to be.

Blue Zushi by Canna Cure Farms is an exotic, indica-dominant hybrid crossed from Zkittlez and Kush Mints. This variety is noted for its high potency and distinct flavor profile that features rich aromatic properties. It is characterized by its specific cannabinoid content, which contributes to its unique position within the local market.

hese compact, premium nugs deliver a rich, aromatic experience with a beautifully frosty appearance and satisfying flavor. Expect a smooth smoke, bold terpene character, and a flavorful finish that makes Baby Budz a perfect choice for any flower enthusiast looking for quality in every nug.

Dr. Green’s Cherries 888 packs a delicious punch in every single bud. This premium 3.5g eighth delivers a smooth smoke and an unforgettable fruity aroma that will leave you feeling blissed out and completely at ease. Grab yours and taste the hype!

Chocolate Dipped Bananas is a Honey Sticks Genetics creation built on the White Truffle line - the White Truffle cut of Gorilla Butter F2 crossed to Dual OG (True OG x Banana OG). The name comes honestly from the terps: creamy ripe banana dipped in dark cocoa, with a hint of OG fuel underneath. A true dessert hybrid in effect, too - a warm cerebral lift up front that settles into a mellow, tension-melting body without putting you to bed.

Diesel Cubez delivers bold flavor and serious bag appeal with dense, resin-coated buds and a distinctive terpene profile. Expect a punchy combination of gassy diesel, sweet fruit, and earthy undertones, creating a rich aroma and lingering flavor from start to finish. A flavorful, aromatic flower for those who appreciate loud terps and standout cultivars.

Gorilla Glue is a classic cultivar known for its dense, resin-coated buds and bold, unmistakable aroma. Expect a rich blend of pungent diesel, earthy pine, and subtle chocolatey sweetness, with a sticky, flavorful finish that showcases its heavy terpene character. Cloud Forest Gorilla Glue is a great choice for fans of classic, gassy flower with a distinctive aroma and plenty of personality.

Sherbacio delivers a decadent combination of sweet, creamy flavor and bold aroma in beautifully dense, frosty buds. Expect layers of sweet sherbet, citrus, creamy gas, and subtle earthy notes, creating a rich terpene profile with a smooth, lingering finish. Cloud Forest Sherbacio is a flavorful standout for anyone who enjoys dessert-inspired flower with plenty of character.

Electraleaf’s Coffin Candy 3.5g flower is a candy-forward hybrid bursting with sweet berry, citrus, and creamy dessert-like flavors. It delivers a smooth, mood-lifting high that starts with euphoric, social energy before easing into a relaxed, body-heavy calm. Flavorful and potent, it’s a versatile strain perfect for both creative sessions and winding down.

Looking for a sweet escape? Purps Crypto Cherries is a high-octane hybrid that hits the sweet spot between heavy-hitting potency and smooth, functional effects. Testing consistently in the 24–30%+ THC range, this strain is a treat for both the palate and the mind.

Donny Burger is Skunk House Genetics' award-winning savory heavyweight - GMO (Garlic Cookies) crossed to Han Solo Burger. If you like loud, funky flower, this is the jar you open twice. The profile is pure delicatessen: sharp cheese and garlic funk cut with lemon and gas. Effects are indica-dominant but social - blissful, giggly, with a calm that spreads through the body rather than knocking you flat.

Take a ride with Romer Farms E-85, a bold and flavorful flower known for its gassy, citrus-forward terpene profile. Dense, frosty buds deliver layers of sweet citrus, earthy fuel, and a smooth, lingering finish. With its eye-catching appearance and unmistakable gas, E-85 is a standout choice for flower enthusiasts who love a loud, terpene-rich experience.

Alchemy Pure Full Send is a convenient 14g pre-ground flower blend designed for customers who want the quality of whole flower without the hassle of breaking it down themselves. Full Send delivers a spicy citrus-forward aroma and flavor, backed by warm earthy notes for a more complex smoking experience. Full Send delivers a spicy citrus-forward aroma and flavor, backed by warm earthy notes for a more complex smoking experience. The combination creates a smooth, full-bodied profile that stands out from ordinary ground flower.

Elevate your rotation with Garlic Sauce, a heavy-hitting Indica-dominant powerhouse from the masters at House of Sacci. This isn't your average floral strain; expect a pungent, savory profile dominated by spicy garlic, earthy musk, and a hint of tangy diesel that lingers on the palate. Expertly cured and precision-packed in a 3.5g jar, these "Dogwalker" sized buds are perfect for those who prioritize deep relaxation and a complex terpene profile. Whether you're looking to unwind after a long day or need a full-bodied nightcap, Garlic Sauce delivers a potent, grounding experience that settles right into the bones.

Canna Cure Farms GG4, also known as Original Glue, is a multi-award-winning indica-dominant hybrid bred from Chem's Sister, Sour Dubb, and Chocolate Diesel. This legendary strain is highly celebrated for its sticky, resin-heavy buds and its robust, complex aromatic profile.

MAC V2 is a flavorful, eye-catching flower known for its dense, frosty buds and standout terpene profile. Expect a smooth blend of sweet, creamy, citrusy, and subtly gassy notes, backed by a rich aroma that makes every session memorable. With its impressive bag appeal and layered flavor, Greenroom MAC V2 is a great pick for anyone looking for premium flower with plenty of character.

Permanent Marker delivers a bold, modern cultivar experience with dense, beautifully frosted buds and a rich, aromatic profile. Expect layers of sweet, gassy, and earthy notes with a smooth, lingering finish. The flower’s striking appearance and complex terpene character make Permanent Marker a standout choice for cannabis enthusiasts looking for something flavorful and distinctive.

The Soap is a standout cultivar featuring dense, frosty buds and a bold, complex terpene profile. Expect a unique combination of sweet, floral, citrusy, and gassy aromas with a smooth, lingering flavor. With its eye-catching appearance and distinctive character, Greenroom The Soap is a great choice for those looking to add something flavorful and unique to their flower rotation.

Halle Berry by Zizzle is a high-THC sativa-dominant hybrid cannabis flower (cross-bred from Ice Cream Cake and Blockberry) featuring sweet berry, citrus orange, and creamy vanilla notes that deliver an uplifting head high paired with mild body relaxation.

This premium flower delivers dense, frosty buds with an enticing blend of sweet, creamy, and earthy notes accented by a subtle gassy finish. With its standout aroma, rich terpene character, and smooth, flavorful smoke, Jokerz #31 is a great choice for those looking for a distinctive and satisfying flower experience.

Bright, citrus-forward, and bursting with fresh flavor, Rythm Lemon Fresh delivers a vibrant cannabis experience built around its unmistakable lemon character. The aroma opens with sharp, zesty citrus and freshly peeled lemon notes, complemented by subtle earthy and herbal undertones that give the profile added depth. On the palate, expect a refreshing blend of tangy lemon, sweet citrus, and light botanical notes that linger with every inhale. The experience starts with an uplifting, clear-headed character that can gradually develop into a relaxed yet balanced sensation. Its lively citrus profile makes Lemon Fresh a great choice for consumers looking for a flavorful strain with an energetic edge, while the developing body effects add a touch of calm without overpowering the bright, refreshing nature of the experience.

Experience the ultimate evening escape with Northern Nights, a premium indica-leaning strain meticulously cultivated for deep relaxation and stress relief. Each smooth hit reveals a rich, sophisticated profile of earthy pine and subtle sweet notes that satisfies the palate. Perfect for unwinding after a long day, this potent flower is your go-to choice for a calm, restful, and high-quality nighttime experience.

Treat yourself to the rich, dessert-inspired profile of Romer Farms Oreoz. This premium flower features dense, frosty buds with layers of sweet cream, chocolate, and earthy gas. Its smooth, flavorful smoke and lingering finish make Oreoz a standout choice for those who enjoy bold, dessert-forward terpene profiles and premium-quality flower.

Saffron is a true indica, with reported effects that can begin with an uplifting, euphoric and mentally engaging feeling before transitioning into a more relaxed body experience. Consumers have reported mood elevation, creativity, focus, calm, and relaxation, making it a versatile option depending on the desired experience. On the nose, Saffron opens with sweet peach and citrus notes, followed by layers of floral spice, pepper, and earthy herbs. The flavor carries that same complexity, combining a candy-like peach sweetness with a subtle peppery finish and savory herbal character. The result is an aromatic experience that is both sweet and sophisticated rather than overwhelmingly fruity.

Runtz Sherbanger is an indoor-grown variety characterized by dense, multi-colored buds. Its aromatic profile is defined by a blend of sweet sherbet, tangy citrus, and deep diesel notes. This 3.5g jar highlights a complex terpene composition for those interested in premium botanical features
